metadata.title: Monochromatic Duotone Portrait with Inline Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, close-up portrait of a man with dark hair and a mustache, rendered in a deep purple and white duotone. The image features a grainy, film-like texture with typography overlaid across the upper third of the composition, utilizing extreme letter spacing.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark hair frames the face and merges into the deep purple background.
The white highlights of the face and teeth provide the primary focal contrast.
The thin, light-colored typography sits atop the darkest areas of the hair for legibility.
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting with visible film grain
Extreme horizontal tracking in the text layout

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, extreme close-up portrait filling the frame from chin to crown.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and smile, positioned in the center-right of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright smile, moves up to the eyes, then scans the wide-tracked text across the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject's hair and the dark background occupy the periphery.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between dark shadows and bright highlights; low color variety.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thin strokes relative to height
characterSpecificRedesigns: Circular 'O' forms contrasting with condensed vertical letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with varying tracking and scale across three lines.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the inline serif quality and classical proportions.
Matches the high-waisted, elegant serif structure.
Similar small-serif structure if inline details are added.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy duotone portrait of a man with a mustache and voluminous 1970s hair, using only shades of deep purple and white. The face should be centered and fill the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of all-caps text in the upper third. Use a thin, inline serif font. Apply extreme horizontal tracking so the text spans the full width of the head.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic purple?
Is the tracking on the text wide enough to feel airy?
Does the grain texture look like vintage film?
Are the highlights on the face bright white?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Original artist name and title text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the dark hair background.
Check that the duotone transition is smooth without banding.
Verify the mustache and hair texture are well-defined in the shadows.
Confirm the typography maintains a light, delicate feel despite the dark background.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast duotone portrait + grainy film texture + wide-tracked inline serif typography in the upper third.
